items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb von zwei Wochen ab seiner Zustellung Einspruch einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Zentralen Bußgeldbehörde Beispielsaarland.
items.computation: The letter was formally served (Postzustellungsurkunde, § 182 ZPO); the scanned delivery-receipt copy on page 2 shows 'zugestellt am 21.11.2026' (Saturday). For formal service the actual service date controls, not the ordinary 3/4-day deemed-delivery fiction. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of service (21.11.) is not counted, so the 2-week period starts 22.11.2026. Under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB a period in weeks ends on the day of the second week bearing the same name as the day of the triggering event, i.e. Saturday 05.12.2026. Since that day is a Saturday, § 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG / § 193 BGB moves the deadline to the next business day. Sunday 06.12. is also excluded, so the deadline falls on Monday 07.12.2026 (not a Saarland public holiday).

items.title: Pay the fine, fee and delivery costs (total €182.00)
items.quote: Zahlen Sie erst, wenn dieser Bescheid rechtskräftig geworden ist, und dann binnen zwei Wochen auf das Konto DE94 5901 0000 0006 6121 00.
items.computation: Payment is expressly conditional on the Bescheid becoming 'rechtskräftig' (final), which happens only if no Einspruch is filed within the objection period computed above (ending 07.12.2026). Assuming no Einspruch is lodged, Rechtskraft occurs with the expiry of 07.12.2026, so the triggering event falls at the end of Monday 07.12.2026. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the countdown for the further 'zwei Wochen' starts the next day, 08.12.2026; under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB two weeks later, on the matching weekday, gives Monday 21.12.2026, which is a normal business day in Saarland, so no further shift applies. If an Einspruch is filed in time, this payment deadline does not arise and is superseded by later proceedings.

warnings: The payment due date (2026-12-21) is only valid if no Einspruch is filed by 2026-12-07; filing an Einspruch stops the fine from becoming final and this payment deadline would not apply.

Page 2 is a scanned copy of the delivery envelope showing a handwritten service date of 21.11.2026; this actual service date, not the standard deemed-delivery rule for ordinary post, was used to compute the Einspruch deadline.

The IBAN DE94 5901 0000 0006 6121 00 is a formally valid German IBAN (Landesmusterbank), but a valid IBAN only confirms its format — confirm payee-name matching at your bank before transferring if in doubt.
